summary: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a $0.10 per share cash dividend to common shareholders, payable May 11, 2026 to holders of record May 4, 2026. The board stated future dividends will depend on financial condition and other factors. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine dividend declaration that does not qualify as a special situation.
